clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, the Hallowed Tablet calls young Darkspear priests to Ken'jai. Its words begin their lessons in communing with the spirits.

Gornek gives the Hallowed Tablet to a promising troll priest taking their first steps through the Valley of Trials. The words carry a personal invitation from Ken'jai, the priest trainer outside the Den. Ken'jai reads signs and hears the spirits' whispers, sensing when young Darkspear with spiritual potential arrive in Durotar. The tablet tells the initiate to read its message and seek Ken'jai's guidance in channeling spiritual authority.
